limitations: The cached Google default geometry was analyzed. The browser-confirmed polyline was not persisted, so this is not that confirmed revision.
Google labeled the route BR-116. Sampled coordinates also follow the Santa Catarina coast before turning inland toward Porto Alegre and Jaguarão.
The Brazilian portion ends at the polyline vertex nearest the Phase 4 Jaguarão reference. Uruguay is outside ANP coverage.
Corridor municipalities are those whose municipal seat is nearest a route sample or within 20 km of the polyline. This is not a municipal-boundary intersection.
ANP coordinates that are more than 80 km from the claimed municipal seat are low quality. Straight-line distance is not a driving detour.
No ANP record in this retrieval contained an explicit Podium product name. Brand Vibra is not Podium evidence.
Authorized tank volume is not evidence of fuel in stock.
Google Places was used only for a stratified sample. Returned hours were not cross-checked against an independent published schedule.
The Places key is restricted to Places API (New) and has no application restriction because the local egress address was not treated as stable.

Public Petrobras locator sample on 2026-11-17, filtered to Gasolina Petrobras Podium, confirmed four ANP premium Vibra stations by address: Posto Gloria in Joinville, Auto Posto Santa Catarina and Posto Modesto 2 in Itapema, and Oceano Atlantico in Santos. Their ANP text says premium gasoline and does not say Podium. A Jaguarão search showed no named markers after two zoom-outs; that view does not prove that no station exists. The sample does not estimate the Podium share of the 157 premium Vibra stations.
